Additionally, the leftmost kangaroo's paws appear melted into the grass and the adjacent raccoon's head, lacking distinct digit definition. The fur texture across all subjects is unnaturally smooth and airbrushed, resembling plastic rather than biological fur. These defects represent fundamental failures in object separation and anatomical integrity.
